# Version 4.157.0
> **Engine and rendering corrections** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 previews Skia m157 with corrections to path rendering, text replay and GPU behavior. The preview line also aligns LibraryImport calling conventions with the existing native ABI. Graphite Metal adopts a newer native iOS and tvOS runtime minimum.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal runtime requirements** — Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later; its native macOS minimum remains 12. Applications using this backend must meet those native requirements as well as any higher managed-framework or integration requirements. Do not lower an application's deployment target based on these native minima. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 157 while retaining the existing managed API surface and the earlier glyph-bounds guard. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Path rasterization and glyph replay** — Corrects coverage-mask clamping and convex-path bounds, fixes a convex anti-aliased path heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, and strengthens direct-mask Slug validation and fractional replay handling. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Graphite clipping and readback** — Corrects clip-key packing and wedge inflation, and fixes the destination stride for alpha-to-RGBx GPU-to-CPU transfers. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Reflected hairlines and text atlases** — Keeps zero-length square-capped hairlines from growing under reflected scaling, guards non-finite cap calculations, and rounds text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong sampler. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Vulkan initialization and device-loss cleanup** — Initializes render-pass pointers correctly. Ganesh and Graphite also delay affected device-loss cleanup paths by 1 ms on ARM proprietary drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Explicit cdecl imports** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify cdecl, matching the DllImport and delegate paths. This addresses an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 explicitly marks generated LibraryImport declarations as cdecl. The package revision does not upgrade the bundled HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine or change the public managed API.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, and adds a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup delay.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport declarations. Graphite Metal's native iOS and tvOS minimum becomes 15; higher framework requirements still apply.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
